description: The identity of a file: its name and the directory holding it. The composed `lix_file` view joins this descriptor with the file's path and content.

columns.name: directory_id
columns.description: Directory holding the file (references `lix_directory_descriptor.id`); null at the repository root.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Stable file identifier (UUIDv7); it survives renames and moves.

columns.name: name
columns.description: File name: the last path segment, extension included.
